brief.prompt: Hey, it’s Marcus. In Chapter 12 Old Ben is in a one-room jail, and Harriet’s parents are past eighty. They could never walk north. So she sends the village children to the junk heap for two wheels and two stout boards, and borrows Jacob Jackson’s old horse. Build the carriage she put together, part by part, and tell me what one part did for the old folks.
